description: Source code for a Zephyr emulator driver for the Bosch BMI160 accelerometer and gyroscope, supporting initialization, register access, and both I2C and SPI bus emulation.

methods.name: emul_bmi160_get_reg_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a register from the emulator's register array.

methods.name: bmi160_emul_backend_set_channel
methods.description: Sets the emulator's sensor channel data, such as accelerometer or gyroscope readings.

methods.name: bmi160_emul_backend_get_sample_range
methods.description: Provides the range of possible sensor samples for a given channel.

methods.name: bmi160_emul_backend_set_offset
methods.description: Sets offset values for sensor channels, simulating calibration.

methods.name: bmi160_emul_backend_set_attribute
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes, such as offsets.

methods.name: bmi160_emul_backend_get_attribute_metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about sensor attributes, including min, max, and shift values.
